kind: Stronger simple pre-reply classification baseline; development only
label: Saved immediate remaining-damage ratio >=0.75, original mistake-maker perspective.
secondary_check: Same two-feature logistic regression with and without Maia.
preprocessing: Median imputer with missing indicators inside training folds. Logistic additionally uses training-fold StandardScaler. No feature selection, calibration, class weighting, threshold selection or hyperparameter search.
controls: Only initial_damage (pp) and opponent_elo (reply-maker rating). No actual reply, future horizon, game result, post-reply evaluation or identity is a predictor.
reference: Fixed shallow LightGBM classifier provides nonlinear effects and interaction of the two controls. Same fixed settings for the augmented classifier. Binary objective is used only in this separate experiment; frozen regressors remain unchanged.
folds: Reuse original three game-fold validation assignments, restricted to four earlier archives. Player check purges whole training games sharing held-out players before filtering the missing-label rows, as in the existing four-archive protocol.
eligibility: 15,851 labeled replies /4,472 games for all methods. 102 missing replies excluded.
intervals: Paired percentile game-cluster bootstrap of fixed held-out predictions, 2000 draws, seed 1701. Positive Brier/log-loss improvement = baseline minus augmented; positive accuracy/balanced-accuracy gains = augmented minus baseline. Conditional on fitted models; no bootstrap refits or multiplicity adjustment.
robustness: >25 and >30 subsets of the same primary >20 predictions; no refits.
